🎥🍿: Super Troopers 3 (2026)

The most outrageous law enforcement team is back for another round of hilarious mayhem. When an unexpected case throws the Vermont State Troopers into the middle of a bizarre criminal scheme, their questionable police work, nonstop pranks, and complete disregard for professionalism somehow become the key to cracking the case.

Packed with the return of the original cast, Super Troopers 3 brings back the absurd humor, unforgettable one-liners, and chaotic antics that turned the franchise into a cult comedy classic. If you loved the first two films, expect even bigger laughs and even crazier shenanigans this time around.

source_details.synopsis: Super Troopers 3 (billed as Super Troopers 3: Farva’s Wedding, onscreen only) is a 2026 American comedy film directed by Jay Chandrasekhar. A sequel to the 2018 film Super Troopers 2, the film was written by and stars the Broken Lizard comedy team, made up of Chandrasekhar, Kevin Heffernan, Steve Lemme, Paul Soter and Erik Stolhanske. Super Troopers 3 was released in the United States by Searchlight Pictures on August 7, 2026, it received mixed reviews from critics.
